78001.name: Late Risers
78001.text:
[skull]: −X, your distance to Lab Omega
[cultist]: −3; on success you may remove a barricade from a connected location
[tablet]: −2; on failure move one location toward Lab Omega.
78001.backText:
[skull]: −X, twice your distance to Lab Omega
[cultist]: −6; on success you may remove a barricade from a connected location
[tablet]: −3; after this test ends, move one location toward Lab Omega.

78002.name: Blocked In
78002.text: At round end, at Lab Omega discard each Terror in your threat area and take 1 horror for each.
78002.backText: Discard all Mindless Thralls in play. If Lab Omega is unrevealed, remove its barricades and reveal it. Shuffle the encounter discard and set-aside Agency Troubleshooters into the encounter deck. Each investigator tests willpower (3); on failure move to Lab Omega.

78003.name: Frantic Search
78003.text: At round end, at Lab Omega discard each Terror in your threat area and take 1 horror for each.
78003.backText: Discard all Mindless Thralls in play. Search the encounter deck and discard for an Agency Troubleshooter and a Mindless Thrall; spawn them at The Tunnel and Lab Omega respectively. Each investigator tests willpower (3); on failure move to Lab Omega.

78004.name: There’s No Way Out
78004.text: At round end, at Lab Omega discard each Terror in your threat area and take 1 horror for each.
78004.backText: Each undefeated investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. Resolve resolution 1.

78005.name: No Better Ideas
78005.text: You cannot enter locations with barricades. [action]: investigators here spend up to 2 clues to remove that many barricades from a connected location. Objective: enter Lab Omega.
78005.backText: Put Central Lobby, Lab Alpha, Lab Delta and The Tunnel into play with their printed barricades. Shuffle the set-aside Twisted Supplicants into the encounter deck.

78006.name: Climb the Barricades
78006.text: You cannot enter locations with barricades. [action]: investigators here spend up to 2 clues to remove that many barricades from a connected location. Objective: enter The Tunnel.
78006.backText: Put Narrow Stair into play. Spawn First Among Many at the Morgue and Greyson at The Tunnel. If you entered from Torn Hallway, Greyson enters exhausted; otherwise record that you triggered the facility alarm.

78007.name: Scylla and Charybdis
78007.text: You cannot enter locations with barricades. [action]: investigators here spend up to 2 clues to remove that many barricades from a connected location. Objective: advance when an Elite enemy enters the victory display.
78007.backText: If Greyson is in the victory display, resolve resolution 2. Otherwise resolve resolution 3.

78008.name: Morgue
78008.flavor: The stench of the green mist rolling in from the door overwhelms your senses far more than the formaldehyde.
78008.backFlavor: There is little sign of how you got here.

78009.name: Lab Omega
78009.text: Miasma. Barricade (1 per investigator). At the start of your turn here, take 1 damage or discard until a Terror treachery and draw it. Victory 1.

78010.name: Central Lobby
78010.text: Enemies here get −1 fight and −1 evade, to a minimum of 1.

78011.name: Lab Alpha
78011.text: Barricade (1 per investigator). [action]: Investigate with combat instead of intellect. On success search the top 9 cards of your deck for an event and draw it; remember that you put out a fire. Group limit once per game. Victory 1.

78012.name: Lab Delta
78012.text: Barricade (1 per investigator). When you investigate, you may increase shroud by 4 for this investigation. On success, investigators here may spend 3 clues per investigator to put Torn Hallway into play. Victory 1.

78013.name: The Tunnel
78013.text: Safe. Barricade (3 per investigator). After you evade an enemy here, if there are no ready enemies here, you may immediately move to a connected location.

78014.name: Narrow Stair
78014.text: If there are no clues here, gain: [action], return all your clues to the pool: Resign. Victory 2.

78015.name: Torn Hallway
78015.text: [action], spend 1 clue: Remove up to 3 barricades from The Tunnel. [action][action]: Take control of the set-aside Suspicious Briefcase. Victory 1.

78016.name: Agent Greyson
78016.text: Alert. Retaliate. [action]: Parley, test intellect (4); on success automatically evade Greyson. While ready, investigators and enemies at her location cannot move or be moved. Victory 2.

78017.name: Suspicious Briefcase
78017.text: [free], exhaust and reveal a chaos token: Gain 3 resources. If skull, cultist or tablet, flip and resolve the story. Forced: exile this if it would leave play or you are defeated.
78017.backText: Record that this investigator imbibed a cardinal reagent. Set the briefcase aside; another investigator who has not imbibed a reagent may take it and put it into play.

78018.name: First Among Many
78018.text: Hunter. Massive. Prey: most Terror treacheries. After you deal damage to this enemy while you are at a Miasma location, take 1 horror. Victory 2.

78019.name: Night on the Town
78019.text:
[skull]: −X. X is the number of locations with Survivors.
[cultist]: −4. If you succeed, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
[tablet]: −3. If you fail, draw the topmost Miasma treachery in the encounter discard pile.
78019.backText:
[skull]: −X. X is the number of locations with Ruins or Survivors.
[cultist]: −6. If you succeed, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
[tablet]: −3. Draw the topmost Miasma treachery in the encounter discard pile.

78020.name: Spreading Uncertainty
78020.text: At the end of the round, at each location with no tokens, reveal it and resolve its Human story as if flipped by the agenda. At each location with attached Miasma, move a clue from the location onto that card.
78020.backText: Spawn Abhorrent Pustule at the General Store.

78021.name: Spreading Corruption
78021.text: At the end of the round, at each location with no tokens, reveal it and resolve its Human story as if flipped by the agenda. At each location with attached Miasma, move a clue from the location onto that card.
78021.backText: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.

78022.name: Community Service
78022.text: When an investigator initiates a Defend test at your location, you may place X of your clues on your location to reduce its difficulty by X. [action], if your location has Survivors: Resign. Objective: at the end of the round, advance if each location has Survivors or is a Ruin.

78023.name: Arkham Advertiser
78023.text: When revealed, put Doyle Jeffries here. After playing an event here, you may draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. Limit once per round.
78023.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78024.name: Bank of Arkham
78024.text: When revealed, put The Vice President here. After successfully investigating here, you may gain 2 resources. Limit once per round.
78024.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78025.name: General Store
78025.text: When revealed, put The Loving Couple here. [free], spend X resources: search the top 2X cards of your deck for an asset and put it into play. Shuffle. Limit once per round.
78025.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78026.name: Hibbs Roadhouse
78026.text: When revealed, put Hibbs here. After succeeding by 2 or more here, you may heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator here. Limit once per round.
78026.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78027.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78027.text: When revealed, put Ma Matheson here. [action]: search your deck for an Ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle. Limit once per round.
78027.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78028.name: Orne Library
78028.text: When revealed, put Henry Armitage here. After drawing cards during upkeep, if you have 5 or more cards in hand, draw 1 card.
78028.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78029.name: River Docks
78029.text: When revealed, put Abner Weems here. An eligible skill committed here gains: after this test ends, you may draw 1 card. Limit once per round.
78029.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78030.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78030.text: When revealed, put Miriam Beecher here. [action]: draw the top encounter card, then search your deck for a Spell or Relic and put it into play. Shuffle. Limit once per round.
78030.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78031.name: Abner Weems
78031.text: [action] Defend: number of skill cards in your discard pile (1 + 2 per investigator).
78031.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78032.name: Doyle Jeffries
78032.text: [action] Defend: number of events in your discard pile (1 + 2 per investigator).
78032.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78033.name: Henry Armitage
78033.text: [action] Defend: number of cards in your hand (4 + 2 per investigator).
78033.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78034.name: Hibbs
78034.text: [action] Defend: any skill (4). You may commit cards and use effects that increase your skill value.
78034.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78035.name: Ma Matheson
78035.text: [action] Defend: highest cost of an Ally you control (3 + 1 per investigator).
78035.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78036.name: Miriam Beecher
78036.text: [action] Defend: highest cost of a non-Ally asset you control (3 + 1 per investigator).
78036.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78037.name: The Loving Couple
78037.text: [action] Defend: number of assets you control (4 + 1 per investigator).
78037.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78038.name: The Vice President
78038.text: [action] Defend: number of resources in your pool (8 + 2 per investigator).
78038.backText: If defended, place Survivors at its location and add this card to the victory display (Victory 1). If flipped by the agenda, replace its location with its Ruin, discard attached cards and move investigators and enemies there.

78039.name: Hibbs
78039.text: You get +1 willpower and +1 agility. When an investigator here would be attacked by an attack of opportunity, exhaust Hibbs to cancel it.

78040.name: Cackling Miasma
78040.text: Attach to the farthest location with clues and no attached Miasma. At the start of your turn there, lose or take 1 damage for each clue on this card. [action]: test [[agility]] (3). On success take 1 of its clues or discard this card.

78041.name: Echoing Miasma
78041.text: Attach to the farthest location with clues and no attached Miasma. At the start of your turn there, lose or take 1 resource for each clue on this card. [action]: test [[willpower]] (3). On success take 1 of its clues or discard this card.

78042.name: Gaseous Ghoul
78042.text: Hunter. Retaliate. After engaging or attacking you, move 1 of your clues onto it. After defeating it, take its clues.

78043.name: Hissing Miasma
78043.text: Attach to the farthest location with clues and no attached Miasma. At the start of your turn there, lose or take 1 card from your hand for each clue on this card. [action]: test [[combat]] (3). On success take 1 of its clues or discard this card.

78044.name: Infectious Outburst
78044.text: If no Miasma has clues on it, search the encounter deck and discard for one, draw it, then shuffle the deck. Otherwise remove a clue from each Miasma in play.

78045.name: Walking Contagion
78045.text: Spawn at the farthest location without Survivors or Ruins. At the end of the round, move a clue from its location onto it. After defeating it, take its clues.

78046.name: Whispering Miasma
78046.text: Attach to the farthest location with clues and no attached Miasma. At the start of your turn there, lose or take 1 horror for each clue on this card. [action]: test [[intellect]] (3). On success take 1 of its clues or discard this card.

78047.name: Dead By Dawn
78047.text:
[skull]: -X. X is the greatest damage on a Re-Animated enemy in play (max 5.)
[cultist]: -3. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to any Re-Animated enemy in play.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, ready the nearest exhausted Re-Animated enemy.
78047.backText:
[skull]: -X. X is 2 + the greatest damage on a Re-Animated enemy in play (max 5.)
[cultist]: -5. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to any Re-Animated enemy in play.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, ready the nearest exhausted Re-Animated enemy.

78048.name: Earthly Remains
78048.text: Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from each Re-Animated enemy.
78048.flavor: The ancient brownstone manor is in disrepair, though someone has clearly been living here for some amount of time. More concerning is the variety of what appear to be corpses spread throughout the house…
78048.backText:
Spawn the top card of the Re-Animated deck.
(If there are 3 or 4 players, also spawn one of the two set-aside Re-Animated enemies from the set-aside zone, at random)
78048.backFlavor:
You hear a switch flip, and machines whir to life. From somewhere in the manor, a bright, luminescent green liquid flows through pipes into a body on a table.
A body that first twitches, then springs to something resembling life.

78049.name: Strange Flesh
78049.text: Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from each Re-Animated enemy.
78049.flavor: Asset Delta-Two appears to be experimenting with a method of raising the dead. Whatever his motivations, the results are unruly, violent and in your way.
78049.backText: Spawn the top card of the Re-Animated deck.
78049.backFlavor:
“I’ve got a lot more corpses where that came from! Don’t test me, you errand boys!”
West fires off another switch, and another of his horrible creatures jolts to life, twitching and screaming.
The Tailors respond with a hail of gunfire, and a terrible thought strikes you. Agents, West, or you… Someone is dying tonight.

78050.name: Weird Science
78050.text:
Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from each Re-Animated enemy.
(Hint - the game will not end when this agenda advances, but new threats will emerge…)
78050.flavor: The walking corpses menace the building. No matter how many times they’re put out of their misery, they get up swinging.
78050.backText: If the Re-Animated deck is empty, remove Herbert West from the game and advance to act 3b. Otherwise, spawn the top card of the Re-Animated deck and flip this agenda back over.
78050.backFlavor: Green liquid bubbles through overhead pipes into another of the countless gurneys. The corpse within quickly begins to stir.

78051.name: Unexpected Attack
78051.text:
Investigators may not leave the Servant’s Entrance.
Objective – When Virgil would be defeated: Immediately advance.
78051.flavor: As you quietly examine the room for signs of West, the figure on the gurney he was pushing bolts upright. In moments, it is upon you, snarling and snapping it’s jaw. This is all the more frightening given that this sentry appears to be missing much of his head.
78051.backText:
Flip Virgil (Lurker at the Threshold) to Virgil (Not Going Anywhere), keeping all damage on it.
Put the set aside West’s Laboratory into play.
For the remainder of the scenario, the following rules apply:
◆ While Re-Animated enemies have damage in excess of their health they do not ready during the upkeep.
◆ Each Re-Animated enemy gains: “Forced – When this enemy takes damage in excess of its health: Exhaust that enemy and disengage it from all investigators.”
Place this card next to the act deck, as a reminder.
78051.backFlavor:
As you dispatch the dying sentry, you hear an agent calling out for Dr. West. His voice rings back from somewhere deep in the manor: “I won’t go back! You hear me? You agency cattle tell Greyson she can get some other genius to solve her mess!”
Suddenly, a gurgling noise comes from behind you. You turn to find the body that you most assuredly just killed rising to its feet.

78052.name: Friendly Doorman
78052.text:
Investigators may not leave the Grand Hall.
Objective – When Ichabod would be defeated: Immediately advance.
78052.flavor: Before you can begin searching for West, a shout draws your intention. An agent is gripped overhead by a massive figure lumbering down the stairs. As the poor agent is torn apart, you see that the hulking defender lacks a head.
78052.backText:
Flip Ichabod (Mindless Drone) to Ichabod (Head of Security), keeping all damage on it.
Put the set aside West’s Laboratory into play.
For the remainder of the scenario, the following rules apply:
◆ While Re-Animated enemies have damage in excess of their health they do not ready during the upkeep.
◆ Each Re-Animated enemy gains: “Forced – When this enemy takes damage in excess of its health: Exhaust that enemy and disengage it from all investigators.”
Place this card next to the act deck, as a reminder.
78052.backFlavor:
As you dispatch the lumbering body, you hear a familiar voice shout from the back of the manor. “I won’t go back! You hear me? You agency cattle tell Greyson she can get some other genius to solve her mess! Ichabod, dispatch these children.”
A wheezing noise comes from directly behind you. Turning, you find the figure that you most assuredly just killed rising to its feet.

78053.name: Careful Contraptions
78053.text: Objective – When an investigator enters West’s Laboratory, advance.
78053.flavor: Asset Delta-Two is Dr. Herbert West, one of your attending physicians at St. Mary’s. The doctor has locked himself behind a variety of contraptions while his gruesome defenders do their work.
78053.backText: Put the set aside Herbert West asset into play at West’s Laboratory.
78053.backFlavor: As the remaining mechanisms of the doors fail, you slam your body against the oaken frame. It buckles, then gives way, sending you sprawling onto the floor. Staring down at you, you notice a set of intense blue eyes. Eyes you recognize from your last moments in St Mary’s.

78054.name: Paging Dr. West
78054.text:
Objective – When an investigator takes control of Herbert West, advance.
(Careful - this will not end the game!)
78054.flavor: You are face to face with the last person you saw before waking up in the morgue. If anyone has answers, it’s him.
78054.backText:
Revelation – Replace the act and agenda decks with Back for More. Spawn the set-aside First Among Many at the Grand Hall.
Forced – When doom is placed on any card: Either resolve the hunter keyword on First Among Many, or resolve the hunter keyword on each Re-Animated enemy in play.

78055.name: Abandoned Room
78055.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a fight or evade test against a Re-Animated enemy at this location: Gain 1 clue from the token bank. (Limit once per phase.)
Victory 1.
78055.flavor: With so much open space, there is ample opportunity to observe the behavior of the walking corpses.
78055.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78055.backFlavor: This room is in extreme disrepair. A gust of chilly night air blows through shattered windows.

78056.name: Apothecary Room
78056.text: [action] If there are no ready Re-Animated enemies at this location, investigators in this location spend 3[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource token on this location. (Group limit once per game.)
78056.flavor: All manner of bizarre tinctures line the dusty shelves. You note the shelves have cleared spots - there must be some hidden mechanism here.
78056.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78056.backFlavor: Just off the main chamber is a room lined wall to wall with bottles and jars.

78057.name: Basement
78057.text: [action] If there is a ready Re-Animated enemy at this location, investigators at this location spend 4[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 2 damage to that enemy, automatically evade it, and place 1 resource token on this location. (Group limit once per game.)
78057.flavor: West is just beyond the door. You try to shove it down, and receive a nasty electrical shock. Maybe there’s some way to short it out…
78057.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78057.backFlavor: While this basement smells musty and ancient, the wiring and lighting implies that someone has been keeping it somewhat up to modern standards.

78058.name: Bedroom
78058.text:
[action]: Evade. This effect can only target a Re-Animated enemy at this location or an adjacent location. Add your [intellect] to your [agility] for this evade. If you succeed, that enemy cannot ready this round. If you fail, heal 2 damage from that enemy.
Victory 1.
78058.flavor: A strange and heavy device, somewhat like a shepherd’s crook, is propped against the wall.
78058.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78058.backFlavor: Someone has been sleeping here for a long time. Scattered notes and piles of laundry litter the room.

78059.name: Corridor
78059.text: [action]: Fight. This effect can only target a Re-Animated enemy at this location or a connecting location. Add your [intellect] to your [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you fail, heal 2 damage from that enemy. (Limit once per round.)
78059.flavor: The hall is filled with dangerous debris that you could easily route the stumbling creatures into…
78059.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78059.backFlavor: A once-ornate hall lines the entire east side of the manor.

78060.name: Grand Hall
78060.text:
[action] If there is an exhausted Re-Animated enemy at this location: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per round.)
[action]: Resign. This is the Tailors’ mess to clean up!
Victory 1.
78060.flavor: An impressive chamber, somewhat lessened by the makeshift cages lining the walls.
78060.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78060.backFlavor: The Tailors have busted down the door and sent some fodders in ahead of you.

78061.name: Servant’s Entry
78061.text: [action] If there are no Re-Animated enemies at this location, investigators in this location spend 2[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource token on this location. (Group limit once per game.)
78061.flavor: Sparse furnishings poorly kept, in no better wear from the treatment of the resident physician. A large boiler burns in the far corner.
78061.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78062.name: Study
78062.text:
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from this location, if an investigator at this location controls the Suspicious Briefcase asset: Deal 2 damage to each Re-Animated enemy in play. (Group limit once per game.)
Victory 1.
78062.flavor: Covered in notes and chemical formulas about some sort of reagent. Maybe there’s something of use here.
78062.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78062.backFlavor: Someone has taken great pains to keep this study in excellent condition. It is almost clinical in its order.

78063.name: Tub Room
78063.text: [action] If there are no ready Re-Animated enemies at this location, investigators in this location spend 3[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource token on this location. (Group limit once per game.)
78063.flavor:
Just past the bathtub are a series of exposed pipes with valves and the sound of constantly flowing water.
You hope it is water.
78063.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78063.backFlavor: Scattered body parts litter this bloody room. A bonesaw and various filthy rags lie on a table next to the tub.

78064.name: West’s Laboratory
78064.text:
[action]: Parley. You try to make West see reason. Place 1 clue from the token bank on Herbert West (3 clues instead if there is an exhausted Re-Animated enemy at West’s Laboratory). Then, if there are at least 3[per_investigator] clues on Herbert West, take control of him.
Victory 1.
78064.backText: An esoteric security system bars your way. You cannot enter West’s Laboratory unless there are three or more locations with resource tokens on them.
78064.backFlavor:
“You’ll not get in here, you overpaid tin soldiers!”
It appears the doctor is not taking visitors at this time.

78065.name: Herbert West
78065.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When an enemy would be defeated at your location, exhaust Herbert West: Instead, heal 2 damage from that enemy. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.

78066.name: Death’s Hold
78066.text: Revelation – Take 2 direct horror. This horror cannot be prevented.

78067.name: The Folly of Man
78067.text: Revelation – Take 2 direct damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

78068.name: Strength of Flesh
78068.text:
Permanent. Cannot leave play.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test where a [skull] token was revealed, exhaust Strength of Flesh: Heal all damage from Strength of Flesh.

78069.name: Unbreakable Will
78069.text:
Permanent. Cannot leave play.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test where a [cultist] token was revealed, exhaust Unbreakable Will: Heal all horror from Unbreakable Will.

78070.name: Virgil
78070.flavor: “The sight of the re-animated is difficult to adjust to, but one grows accustomed to many things with experience”
78070.backText:
Spawn – Servant’s Entry.
Hunter. Cannot be defeated.
78070.backFlavor: “It does not matter how poor of condition a subject was in when retrieved. Recency of death is the sole defining factor in successful reagent application.”

78071.name: Ichabod
78071.text:
Prey – Lead Investigator.
Hunter. Alert. Retaliate.
78071.flavor: “One needs witness only a single result of my serum to understand the startling effects it will have on all of humanity!”
78071.backText:
Spawn – Grand Hall.
Hunter. Alert. Retaliate. Cannot be defeated.
Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from Ichabod.
78071.backFlavor: “Once properly motivated, subjects can be guided and even follow simple commands. That proper motivation requires removal of the head is admittedly a flaw.”

78072.name: Aristotle
78072.text:
Spawn – Study.
Hunter. Cannot be defeated.
Forced – When you would damage Aristotle, if there is another ready Re-Animated enemy at its location: Deal that damage to that enemy, instead.
78072.flavor: “This test subject shows a heightened mental capacity. Utilized mainly as a sort of survival instinct.”

78073.name: Banquo
78073.text:
Spawn – Grand Hall.
Hunter. Aloof. Cannot be defeated.
Forced – At the start of the enemy phase, if Banquo is ready and unengaged: It attacks each investigator at its location.
78073.flavor: “It can be difficult to differentiate failed trials from wholly successful ones at times. Caution is key.”

78074.name: Brutus
78074.text:
Spawn – Bedroom.
Hunter. Retaliate. Cannot be defeated.
78074.flavor: “The violent urges exhibited by the majority of the subjects is undesirable. In truth, I have found it is not without its uses…”

78075.name: Halsey
78075.text:
Spawn – Basement.
Alert. Cannot be defeated.
78075.flavor: “Whole parts. I had never tried whole parts, before Halsey. The results proved it a misguided venture.”

78076.name: Homer
78076.text:
Spawn – Abandoned Room.
Cannot be defeated.
78076.flavor: “Repeated testing has determined the serum’s effects did, in fact, reverse his intense ocular deterioration. He just doesn’t seem that keen on moving.”

78077.name: Ophelia
78077.text:
Spawn – Corridor.
Prey – Lowest remaining sanity only.
Hunter. Cannot be defeated.
78077.flavor: “The serum appears to have greatly increased her ventromedial cortex activity. Which would explain the almost continuous cackling.”

78078.name: Can’t Get Away!
78078.text: Revelation – Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, you must either take 1 horror for each point you failed by, or ready the furthest Re-Animated enemy and move it directly to your location.

78079.name: Fear the Walking Dead
78079.text:
Revelation – Put Fear the Walking Dead into play in your threat area.
Forced – After you enter a location with a Re-Animated enemy: Take 1 horror.
[free] If there is a Re-Animated enemy at your location with at least 4 damage on it: Discard Fear the Walking Dead.

78080.name: Strength of Flesh
78080.text:
Revelation – Attach to the nearest Re-Animated enemy.
Attached enemy gets +2 health, deals +1 horror, and gains “Forced – At the end of the round: Remove 1 damage from this enemy.”
Forced – After the attached enemy attacks: Discard Strength of Flesh.

78081.name: The Tomb-Legions
78081.text:
Peril.
Revelation – You must either (choose one):
◆ Move each unengaged Re-Animated enemy one location towards you.
◆ Ready the nearest damaged Re-Animated enemy and heal all damage from it.

78082.name: First Among Many
78082.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
First Among Many gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each enemy beneath it.
Forced – At the start of the enemy phase: Place each other enemy at First Among Many’s location beneath it.
Objective – If First Among Many is defeated: (→R4)
Victory 2.
78082.flavor: It speaks your deepest fears in the tones of your father.

78083.name: Mourning Chorus
78083.text:
[skull]: –X. X is the highest number of doom on an enemy in play (max 4).
[cultist]: –3 (–5 if you are at a Miasma location). If you succeed, place 1 resource on your location (*from the token pool*).
[tablet]: –3. If you fail, place 1 resource on the current agenda (*from the token pool*). This effect may cause the Procession to move.
78083.backText:
[skull]: –X. X is 1 greater than the highest number of doom on an enemy in play (max –6).
[cultist]: –4 (–6 if you are at a Miasma location). If you succeed, place 1 resource on your location (*from the token pool*).
[tablet]: –3. Place 1 resource on the current agenda (*from the token pool*). This effect may cause the Procession to move.

78084.name: Eldritch Procession
78084.text:
*This agenda has +2[per_investigator] doom threshold.
Each enemy gets +X health, where X is the number of doom on that enemy.
Forced – When you would resolve the ‘Place 1 doom on the current agenda’ step of the mythos phase: Instead, place 1[per_investigator] resources on the current agenda.
Forced – If this agenda has 2 or more resources on it: Remove 2 resources and move the Procession.
78084.flavor: A procession of infected follow a bizarre abomination through the terrified city.
78084.backText:
Return all resources that were on this agenda to the token bank.
Place 1 doom on the Priest of Plagues.
Discard any non-Elite enemy from the procession, and spawn the set-aside Worshipful Thrall into play (at the discarded enemy’s location, if able) as part of the Procession. Do not place 1 doom on this enemy.
78084.backFlavor:
One of the procession’s number is overcome by rapturous emotions. The procession halts for a moment, circling around the unfortunate soul. You watch in abject terror as the poor man’s flesh falls from his bones, his voice still singing all the while.
Before this terrible sight can shake the infected townsfolk from their revelry, another figure steps in to take the place.

78085.name: Song of Sacrifice
78085.text:
*This agenda has +2[per_investigator] doom threshold.
Each enemy gets +X health, where X is the number of doom on that enemy.
Forced – When you would resolve the ‘Place 1 doom on the current agenda’ step of the mythos phase: Instead, place 1[per_investigator] resources on the current agenda.
Forced – If this agenda has 2 or more resources on it: Remove 2 resources and move the Procession.
78085.flavor: The horrible chorus is reaching a fever pitch. Your time is running short.
78085.backText:
Remember that the Priest of Plagues’ current location is “the site of unbinding”.
(→R1)
78085.backFlavor:
The chorus is deafening. You fall to your knees, unable to even move. Just above the rapturous terror, you hear a voice yell “Fire!”
A massive explosion rocks the city. And another. And another. The entire procession, as well as several city blocks around the priest, are destroyed in a hail of mortar fire.
The sky goes red with bloody mist.

78086.name: Unstoppable Force
78086.text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove 1 doom from that enemy. (Limit once per round.)
78086.flavor: You watch as an agent fires on the horrible priest. The gunfire has no effect, and with a flick of its glowing tail the agent has joined the chorus. There must be some other way to fight it off…
78086.backText:
Shuffle 1 set-aside *Fallen Arkham* Elite enemy and the Procession discard pile into the Procession deck.
Until the end of the game, each Infected enemy gains: “Forced – After this enemy enters a location with any Barricades: Remove as many Barricades as possible, up to this enemy’s remaining health. Deal that much damage to this enemy.”
Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 2a.
78086.backFlavor: As you begin to lose hope that any of your talents will be of any use, you watch a raging citizen drive a truck directly up against the Priest. While the initial impact and explosion do nothing to harm the beast, the creature does not change its path to avoid the accident. With horrible tearing noises, the grotesque monster drags itself directly through the flaming wreckage. By the time it reaches the opposite side, it has begun to bleed…

78087.name: Immovable Objects
78087.text:
[reaction] After you resolve an ability on a Stable location: Place 1 resource on that location, as a Barricade. Then, if there are 3[per_investigator] resources on that location and you have “rallied” fewer than two locations, remember that you have “rallied” that location.
[action] Spend up to 2 clues, as a group: Place that many Barricades on your location.
Objective – When the Priest of Plagues is defeated, advance.
78087.flavor: You have the solution. If you can build up giant barricades in the path of the Priest, it will tear itself to pieces breaking through them!
78087.backText:
Remember that the Priest of Plagues’ current location is “the site of unbinding”.
(→R2)
78087.backFlavor:
With a hideous cry, the head of the priest is sheared from its writhing body. A body that begins smoking, and then detonates in a bloody mess. The viscera begins raising into the sky…
The worshippers sing a final bar, and then fall to the earth, convulsing.

78088.name: Arkham Advertiser
78088.text: [reaction] After you play an event at this location: Draw 1 card and gain 1 resource. (Limit once per round.)
78088.flavor: The writers of the advertiser are quick to detail every move you make and hand you a stipend for being particularly newsworthy.
78088.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78088.backFlavor: Rising above the din of the running presses, Doyle Jeffries utilizes years of practice throwing screaming fits to warn the survivors of Arkham.

78089.name: Bank of Arkham
78089.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate this location: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per round.)
78089.flavor: Negotiating with the tellers for funds takes time, but you both know the Bank’s vaults would take an eternity to empty.
78089.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78089.backFlavor: The institution of Arkham’s elite has become a fortress protecting all of Arkham’s citizens.

78090.name: General Store
78090.text: [action] Spend any number of resources: Search the top X cards of your deck for an asset and put it into play, where X is twice the number of resources you spent. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
78090.flavor: The matron of the establishment helps you sift through the remaining stock, looking for anything you might use.
78090.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78090.backFlavor: From the smoke coming from the chimney, you can tell the store survived the night.

78091.name: Hibb’s Roadhouse
78091.text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more at this location: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from a card you control.(Limit once per round.)
78091.flavor: The patrons of the roadhouse gamble on your actions and cheer you on with every victory.
78091.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78091.backFlavor: A patron pulls a curtain to the side and spots you. He smiles, nods, and makes a shooting gesture.

78092.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78092.text: [action]: Search your deck for an Ally asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
78092.flavor: The boarding house is filled with all sorts, just happy to stand together against the darkness.
78092.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78092.backFlavor: There’s always room for one more at Ma’s!

78093.name: Orne Library
78093.text: [reaction] After the draw cards step of upkeep, if you have 5 or more cards in hand: Draw 1 card.
78093.flavor: The calm demeanor of the library gives you a chance to focus, and Professor Armitage is always ready with helpful advice.
78093.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78093.backFlavor: How useful one library can be!

78094.name: River Docks
78094.text: [reaction] When you commit an eligible skill card to a skill test at this location: It gains [wild] and the text: “After this test ends, you may draw 1 card.” (Limit once per round.)
78094.flavor: There’s plenty of dockhands ready to help with anything you might struggle with.
78094.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78094.backFlavor: You’ll happily throw your lot in with the dockworkers, who seem to have their warehouses well under watch.

78095.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78095.text: [action]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, search your deck for a Spell or Relic asset and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)
78095.flavor: This power is not free, but what’s a little risk when your world’s on the line?
78095.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.
78095.backFlavor: You see the venerable store, and realize just how many powerful relics might be at your disposal inside…

78104.name: Priest of Plagues
78104.text:
Massive.
Cannot be damaged by player cards or player effects.
Forced – After Priest of Plagues moves: Place 1 clue on its location. Then, if it entered a Miasma location, place 2 doom on the last enemy in the Procession. Otherwise, Grow the Procession.
Victory 2.
78104.flavor: It sings songs of death, and you ache to join the chorus.

78105.name: Minister of Sickness
78105.text: Forced – After Minister of Sickness enters play: Move 1 doom from another enemy to the current agenda.

78106.name: Call of Unbinding
78106.text:
Revelation – Put Call of Unbinding into play in your threat area.
Forced – After you defeat an enemy: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[action] Spend 2 clues: Discard Call of Unbinding.

78107.name: Choral Miasma
78107.text:
Revelation – Attach to the location with the most clues without a Choral Miasma attached.
Forced – When an enemy enters Choral Miasma’s location, if there is no doom on Choral Miasma: Move that enemy’s doom to Choral Miasma.
Forced – If there are no clues on attached location: Discard Choral Miasma.

78108.name: March of the Infected
78108.text: Revelation – Test [agility] (6). This test gets –1 difficulty for each enemy in play. For each point you fail by, you must either add 1 resource to the current agenda or take 1 damage.
78108.flavor: How can they move that fast!?

78109.name: Profane Prayer
78109.text:
Peril.
Revelation – You must decide (choose one):
• Grow the Procession.
• Reveal the top card of the procession deck. It attacks you as if it were at your location. Shuffle that card back into the procession deck.

78110.name: Sacrifice of the Profane
78110.text: Revelation – Test [agility] (3). If you fail, choose the nearest enemy with doom on it. You must either take direct damage equal to the amount of doom that enemy, or move all doom on that enemy to the current agenda.
78110.flavor: Life is a small price to pay for the devoted.

78250.name: Agency Troubleshooter
78250.text: Hunter. Retaliate. After attacking during the enemy phase, disengage this enemy and move one location away from the nearest Safe location.

78251.name: Jury-Rigged Incendiary
78251.text: Attach to your location. Before an investigator leaves, discard this and deal 3 damage to every investigator and enemy here. [action]: Test agility (3); on success discard this. After revealing a token, you may end your turn to ignore that token and automatically succeed.

78252.name: Panicked Agent
78252.text: Alert. After making an attack of opportunity, deal 1 damage to every investigator at this location, then automatically evade this enemy.

78253.name: Suppressing Fire
78253.text: Revelation: Test agility (4). On failure, move one location away from the nearest Safe location. If you fail by 2 or more, take 2 damage.

78256.name: Idle Hands
78256.text: Put this in your threat area. During your turn, take 2 damage and discard this as a free ability to gain 1 action. At the end of your turn, take 1 horror.

78257.name: Twisted Supplicant
78257.text: Hunter. Prey: most Terror treacheries. Attacks deal +1 damage and +1 horror if you have a Terror treachery in your threat area.

78258.name: Under Your Skin
78258.text: Put this in your threat area. After you successfully investigate or fight, discard 1 random card from hand. [action][action]: Discard this.

78259.name: Bad News
78259.text: Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, discard each non-weakness event in your hand. If you failed and no events were discarded this way, Bad News gains surge.
78259.flavor: The headlines alone are enough to make you retch.

78260.name: Doyle Jeffries
78260.text:
Hunter. Alert.
Forced – When an investigator at Doyle Jeffries’ location or a connecting location plays an event: Ready Doyle Jeffries. If he is engaged with an investigator, he makes an immediate attack.
Victory 1.

78261.name: Bankrupture
78261.text: Revelation – You may spend any number of resources. Test [agility] (X), where X is 1 greater than the number of resources in your pool. Reduce the difficulty of this test by the number of resources you spent. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.

78262.name: The Vice President
78262.text:
Hunter.
The Vice President gets + 1[per_investigator] damage and + 1[per_investigator] horror.
Forced – When The Vice President attacks: each investigator at its location may spend any number of resources. Reduce the damage and/or horror of this attack by the number of resources spent.
Victory 1.

78263.name: Worked To The Bone
78263.text:
Revelation – Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Worked To The Bone into play in your threat area.
Forced – After you commit 1 or more skill cards to a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or discard a card at random.
[free] If you have no skill cards in hand: Discard Worked To The Bone.

78264.name: The Thing in the Water
78264.text:
Massive. Hunter.
As an additional cost to fight or evade The Thing in the Water, you must commit all eligible skill cards from your hand.
Victory 1.
78264.flavor: It has grown fat on the muscle of the skilled.

78265.name: Damaged Goods
78265.text:
Revelation – Attach to a non-permanent asset you control. If you control no non-permanent assets, this card gains surge.
[action]: Take 2 damage and discard Damaged Goods.
Forced – After you play an asset: Discard attached asset. Attach Damaged Goods to the played asset.

78266.name: The Loving Couple
78266.text:
Hunter.
The Loving Couple gets +1 health for each non-permanent asset controlled by an investigator at its location.
Victory 1.
78266.flavor: Their love transcends the material and the moral.

78267.name: Bone Dry
78267.text:
Revelation – Put Bone Dry into play in your threat area with 3 resources on it. If there are no resources on Bone Dry, discard it.
Forced – When you would succeed by 2 or more at a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or fail by 1 instead. Remove 1 resource from Bone Dry.

78268.name: Hibbs
78268.text:
Hunter. Retaliate. Alert.
Forced – After you successfully fight or evade Hibbs by 2 or more: You must either place 1 doom on Hibbs or it attacks you.
Victory 1.
78268.flavor: He may have had it coming, but you let this happen.

78269.name: Broken Trust
78269.text:
Revelation – Attach to an Ally asset you control. If you control no Ally assets, Broken Trust gains surge.
Treat attached asset’s text box as if it were blank.
[action] Spend 1 resource, plus 1 additional resource for each damage and/or horror on attached asset: Discard Broken Trust.

78270.name: Ma Matheson
78270.text:
Hunter.
Forced – After Ma Matheson attacks, if any amount of damage and/or horror was assigned to an Ally asset: Exile that asset.
Victory 1.

78271.name: Whispers of Power
78271.text:
Revelation – Attach to the highest cost non-Ally asset you control.
As an additional cost to trigger an ability on the attached card, take 1 horror.
Attached card gains “[action]: Return this asset to your hand and discard all attached copies of Whispers of Power.”

78272.name: Miriam Beecher
78272.text:
Hunter.
Miriam Beecher deals X total damage and/or horror divided as evenly as possible, where X is the cost of the highest cost non-Ally asset controlled by an investigator at her location.
Victory 1.
78272.flavor: She has become more dangerous than anything she collected.

78273.name: You Know Too Much
78273.text:
Revelation – Put this card into play in your threat area.
Forced – At the end of your turn: Take X horror, where X is 4 fewer than the number of cards in your hand. Then, discard You Know Too Much.
78273.flavor: Your mind is not your own.

78274.name: Henry Armitage
78274.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Henry Armitage gets +1 damage and +1 horror while engaged with an investigator with 5 or more cards in their hand.
Forced – After an investigator at Henry Armitage’s location draws a card: Henry Armitage engages and attacks that investigator.
Victory 1.
78274.flavor: Even the strongest wills bow to the Bearer of Plagues.

78275.name: Arkham Advertiser
78275.text: At the start of your turn here, reveal an event from your hand or discard. Take X damage and/or horror in total, where X is its cost. If it costs 0, remove it from the game.
78275.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78276.name: Bank of Arkham
78276.text: At the start of your turn here, lose half your resources, rounded up.
78276.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78277.name: General Store
78277.text: At the start of your turn here, discard an asset you control; two if you control 5 or more.
78277.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78278.name: Hibbs Roadhouse
78278.text: At the start of your turn here, choose your highest skill and reduce it to 1 for the rest of the phase.
78278.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78279.name: Ma’s Boarding House
78279.text: At the start of your turn here, take damage or horror equal to the total health or sanity of your highest-cost Ally. You cannot choose a zero value.
78279.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78280.name: Orne Library
78280.text: At the start of your turn here, discard down to 3 cards in hand.
78280.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78281.name: River Docks
78281.text: At the start of your turn here, reveal a skill from your hand. Discard it or take horror equal to its icons.
78281.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78282.name: Ye Olde Magick Shoppe
78282.text: At the start of your turn here, draw an encounter card or discard your highest-cost non-Ally asset.
78282.backText: Unrevealed location. Enter it to reveal its other side.

78283.name: Grinning Victim
78283.text: Hunter. After engaging you, lose an action. If you cannot, it attacks you.

78284.name: Driving Urge
78284.text: Revelation: Test willpower (4). On failure, move one location toward the nearest Miasma location. If you fail by 2 or more, take 2 horror.

78285.name: Not Yourself
78285.text: Put this in your threat area. Each time you move, lose 1 resource. At turn end, test willpower (3); on success discard this. At a Miasma location you may take 1 horror to automatically succeed.

78288.name: Mindless Thrall
78288.text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest Miasma location). At the end of the enemy phase, if at a Miasma location, place 1 doom on this enemy.

78289.name: Worshipful Thrall
78289.text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest Miasma location). After the hunter movement step, if at a Miasma location, search the encounter deck and discard for a Mindless Thrall and spawn it here. Victory 1.

78292.name: Tenuous Allies
78292.text: Attached card does not take up any slots, and gains: “Forced – When the game ends or this card would leave play: Remove this card and Tenuous Allies from the game.”

78020b.name: Abhorrent Pustule
78020b.text: Massive. Hunter. After taking 2 or more damage from one source, return a clue from the nearest location without Survivors or Ruins to the pool. Victory 2.

78054b.name: Back for More
78054b.text:
Revelation – Replace the act and agenda decks with Back for More. Spawn the set-aside First Among Many at the Grand Hall.
Forced – When doom is placed on any card: Either resolve the hunter keyword on First Among Many, or resolve the hunter keyword on each Re-Animated enemy in play.

78070b.name: Virgil
78070b.text:
Spawn – Servant’s Entry.
Hunter. Cannot be defeated.
78070b.flavor: “It does not matter how poor of condition a subject was in when retrieved. Recency of death is the sole defining factor in successful reagent application.”

78071b.name: Ichabod
78071b.text:
Spawn – Grand Hall.
Hunter. Alert. Retaliate. Cannot be defeated.
Forced – At the end of the round: Heal 1 damage from Ichabod.
78071b.flavor: “Once properly motivated, subjects can be guided and even follow simple commands. That proper motivation requires removal of the head is admittedly a flaw.”
